label: Admissible root withholding cells supply accessible per-effect withholding (inference)
rule: Apply setoid reflexivity and map the withholding representative to an admissible world
meaning: Re-presentation of premise (a) in the choice register, not independent support for it (#2103). For the same actual root and grounded actual concretum, the representative belongs to its own withholding cell (WITHHOLD_1) by reflexivity. The map sends it to an accessible world where the root exists and where it does not give that concretum being (WITHHOLD_2). The proof uses the cell only at its representative, and 46a468b2 is the only passage from sense 1 to sense 2; no agentive content of sense 1 is carried into fbd0a6d3. With the branching frame, moment and world map unconstrained and at most one actual root (which a common actual root secures: uniqueRootOfCommonRoot), some representation satisfies both premises exactly when fbd0a6d3 holds (Lean cellsRepresentationIff, discrete partition). The argument adds warrant for fbd0a6d3 only if an independently fixed decision partition and world map are supplied. Its restates_conclusion marker (#2190) makes the frontier close fbd0a6d3 through it only by rule (d), when every premise is closed. Neither uniformity across effects nor a fixed setup is a premise of this per-effect conclusion.
